index.description: Zero-based position in the original input list.

url.description: Requested URL. Repeated inputs retain separate report rows.

ok.description: Whether this input refers to a file included in the ZIP.

fileName.description: Filename inside the ZIP, or null when no file was included.

bytes.description: Uncompressed file size in bytes. Duplicate successful rows refer to the same archive entry.

error.description: Failure reason, including Skipped: spending limit reached for URLs excluded before downloading.

durationMs.description: Download duration in milliseconds; zero for spending-limit skips.
